desc: The next level of strength and versatility, the Warne Skyline Lite Bipod is rugged and adaptable to suit any shooting endeavor. Machined from aircraft-grade aluminum, it was engineered to be an extremely stable, yet lightweight platform, packed with essential features to complement rapid-fire and precision-shooting alike. The Skyline Lite Bipod allows for an impressive 4.65 inches of height adjustment and 44 of smooth cant range that is easily manipulated and locked out without coming off target.
